business_problem: Demandbase needed near-real-time call intelligence in Salesforce without forcing reps and analysts to spend hours entering notes, reviewing calls manually, or piecing together account risk and opportunity signals across teams.
solution_summary: Demandbase adopted Momentum from Salesforce as an AI layer on top of its revenue operations stack to turn every customer-facing conversation into structured data and shared context. Momentum records and scrapes Zoom calls, extracts the information that matters, and syncs it back into Sales Cloud in near real time so reps no longer have to type meeting notes or update deal fields by hand. Its models analyze conversations for churn indicators, upsell signals, and other account risks or opportunities, helping Demandbase react before issues escalate. Slack and Sales Cloud are then linked through dedicated Account Rooms that consolidate account details, alerts, and opportunities for cross-functional teams. Momentum also generates executive briefs that summarize themes across hundreds of weekly calls, replacing manual analyst curation with AI-driven insight for leadership.

solution_components.name: Momentum from Salesforce
solution_components.role: Records calls, extracts insights, and generates summaries and alerts from conversation data.

solution_components.name: Sales Cloud
solution_components.role: Receives synced call data and operational account context for revenue teams.

solution_components.name: Slack
solution_components.role: Hosts shared Account Rooms where teams review risks, opportunities, and summaries.

data_flow: Customer conversations in Zoom are captured by Momentum from Salesforce, which extracts insights and syncs them into Sales Cloud. Risks, upsell signals, and leadership summaries are then distributed through Slack Account Rooms so sales and product teams can act on the same account context.
business_outcome: Demandbase reduced manual admin, surfaced risk and upsell signals sooner, gave leadership better forecasting insight, and helped sales teams focus more of their time on active selling.
architecture_clues: Momentum summarizes trends across hundreds of calls each week for executives.
Account Rooms centralize account details, risks, and opportunities in Slack.
Conversation analysis is used for both churn risk detection and upsell identification.
